parameters.description: Canonical QIAprep silica-spin alkaline-lysis sequence for the benchmark's high-copy E. coli scenario.

citations.title: A rapid alkaline extraction procedure for screening recombinant plasmid DNA
citations.tier_justification: Primary paper establishes the alkaline-lysis principle; it does not establish QIAprep's proprietary buffer labels.

citations.title: QIAGEN QIAprep Miniprep Handbook (December 2020)
citations.tier_justification: Official QIAprep protocol specifies Buffer P1, then Buffer P2, followed by neutralization with Buffer N3.

parameters.description: Reference culture volume used by the benchmark yield calibration. Five millilitres is the upper endpoint of the supported 1-5 mL high-copy QIAprep range, not a universal biological optimum.

citations.title: QIAGEN QIAprep Miniprep Handbook (December 2020)
citations.tier_justification: Official protocol supports 1-5 mL overnight LB cultures for high-copy plasmids; choosing 5 mL as the benchmark reference point is an explicit task calibration.

parameters.description: Supported overnight LB culture-volume range for the benchmark's high-copy plasmid QIAprep workflow.

citations.title: QIAGEN QIAprep Miniprep Handbook (December 2020)
citations.tier_justification: Official microcentrifuge protocol is designed for high-copy plasmid DNA from 1-5 mL overnight E. coli cultures in LB medium.

parameters.description: Minimum positive integer lysis duration accepted by this benchmark. The 1-minute lower bound is an input-contract calibration, not an independently published biological threshold.

citations.title: QIAGEN QIAprep Miniprep Handbook (December 2020)
citations.tier_justification: Official protocol defines a timed P2 lysis step and a 5-minute maximum; the exact 1-minute lower bound reflects the benchmark's positive-integer action space.

parameters.description: Maximum P2 lysis duration before QIAprep N3 neutralization; longer alkaline exposure can irreversibly denature plasmid DNA.

citations.title: QIAGEN QIAprep Miniprep Handbook (December 2020)
citations.tier_justification: Official protocol says not to allow P2 lysis to proceed for more than 5 minutes; the handbook attributes long alkaline exposure to irreversible plasmid denaturation.

parameters.description: Finite aliases accepted for the QIAprep 2.0 silica-membrane spin-column workflow. Generic QIAGEN-column and anion-exchange terms are intentionally excluded because they identify different or ambiguous products.

citations.title: QIAGEN QIAprep Miniprep Handbook (December 2020)
citations.tier_justification: Official handbook defines QIAprep 2.0 Spin Columns as silica-membrane columns for the bind-wash-elute miniprep workflow.

parameters.description: Minimum and standard QIAprep 2.0 spin-column elution volume. Decision scoring treats the standard 50 uL condition as optimal while the simulator supports 50-100 uL.

citations.title: QIAGEN QIAprep Miniprep Handbook (December 2020)
citations.tier_justification: Official QIAprep spin protocol recommends 50 uL Buffer EB or water and permits 50-100 uL; lower volumes trade recovery for concentration rather than preventing matrix carryover.

parameters.description: Maximum supported QIAprep 2.0 spin-column elution volume for this benchmark.

citations.title: QIAGEN QIAprep Miniprep Handbook (December 2020)
citations.tier_justification: Official handbook permits 50-100 uL Buffer EB or water for elution, with 50 uL as the standard recommended condition.

parameters.description: Deterministic simulator calibration for the nominal A260/A280 observation. The degenerate 1.8-1.8 interval is not a universal biological acceptance range or a standalone purity diagnosis.

citations.title: Thermo Fisher Assessment of Nucleic Acid Purity (Technical Note 52646)
citations.tier_justification: Technical note states that approximately 1.8 is generally accepted for DNA and approximately 2.0 for RNA; the exact deterministic 1.8 output remains a benchmark calibration.

parameters.description: Deterministic simulator yield calibration of 10 ug at the 5 mL reference culture volume. This is not a universal empirical yield claim.

citations.title: QIAGEN QIAprep Miniprep Handbook (December 2020)
citations.tier_justification: Official QIAprep 2.0 spin-column protocol supports yields up to 20 ug; 10 ug at 5 mL is an explicit conservative simulator calibration within that capacity, not a handbook-reported fixed yield.
